dialogues.speaker: Suling
dialogues.text: Hello there, Traveler! Sorry for the scant welcome, but I need to check on our weapon readiness, as always...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me more about yourself, if you would...

dialogues.speaker: Suling
dialogues.text: I'm the Alcor's chief smith. I'm also in charge of all the weapons used in this fleet.

dialogues.speaker: Suling
dialogues.text: If you're looking for a metalsmith, go hit Hanfeng's Ironmongers up. The boss there, Master Zhang, is my cousin. His craft is the finest there is in Liyue Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Suling
dialogues.text: When it comes to smithing metals, I'm not his equal... but if we talk about familiarity with weapons, I don't believe myself inferior to anyone.

dialogues.speaker: Suling
dialogues.text: I joined Captain Beidou's crew to get a chance to look at rare and unusual weaponry.

dialogues.speaker: Suling
dialogues.text: Heh, well, it's actually alright. The busiest I've been lately was when we were back in Inazuma. The Captain even told me to get geared up for some rough times.

dialogues.speaker: Suling
dialogues.text: I heard the other crew members praising you to the skies after our romp there.

dialogues.speaker: Suling
dialogues.text: Well, if you've got any ideas on how we can improve our weaponry, remember to give me a shout!

dialogues.speaker: Suling
dialogues.text: Sorry, but I still need to check on our weapon readiness. If this isn't important, then don't bother me.
